gbm_population_evidence.quote: Adult (\> 18 years old) patients with newly diagnosed or recurrent high grade glioma with newly confirmed pathology (within 1 month)

candidate_evidence.quote: To investigate the relationship between dynamic MRI, brain tumor perfusion (DSC) and permeability (DCE), and dynamic 18F-FAZA PET uptake.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: patients with newly diagnosed or recurrent high grade glioma

agents.drug_class_hint: 18F-labelled hypoxia PET imaging tracer (fluoroazomycin arabinoside, FAZA); isotope 18F

source_quote.quote: To investigate the relationship between tumors with greater hypoxia defined by qBOLD and 18F-FAZA PET and pathological features including proportionate necrosis, Ki-67 and IDH mutation status

coder_notes: Imaging-only Early Phase 1 study of 18F-FAZA PET in high grade glioma and cervical cancer; glioblastoma is not named anywhere, so high_grade_glioma_unspecified. Only intervention is a diagnostic PET tracer; no candidate. Gadolinium MRI contrast is mentioned but is not a registered intervention, so not listed (R9). IDH mutation status listed as exploratory correlative from the secondary objective in the brief summary (no outcome entry); Ki-67 is routine histology and not recorded. Active moiety named as tracer with isotope since it is a diagnostic form; development name in record is 18F-FTX.
